prompt: Name a ten-letter English word with no repeated letter. Inflections count; proper names do not.
source: ENABLE word list (Mendel Cooper), public domain; exact letter filter.

prompt: Name an English word containing at least three consecutive vowels (A, E, I, O, U). Inflections count.
source: ENABLE word list (Mendel Cooper), public domain; exact letter filter.

prompt: Name an English word with a silent first letter in a standard pronunciation. Inflections count.
source: ENABLE × CMU Pronouncing Dictionary; initial consonant and first-phoneme checks. CMU BSD license in DATA-SOURCES.md.

prompt: Name a non-avian dinosaur genus. Flying reptiles, marine reptiles, and modern birds do not count.
source: Paleobiology Database API, accepted extinct regular genera under Dinosauria, excluding Aves. Snapshot 2026-10-21; CC BY 4.0.

prompt: Name a bird species recorded in North America. Vagrants, introduced birds, and extinct species count; use a species name, not just “eagle.”
source: Corpora birds_north_america, derived from ABA checklist; CC0. Historical checklist names retained.

prompt: Name a cheese, cultured milk, or other fermented dairy product. Traditional varieties and named cheeses count.
source: Corpora foods/curds, CC0; normalized duplicates merged, common dairy forms added. Scope includes fermented milks as well as cheeses.

prompt: Name a culinary herb, spice, or named spice blend. Both individual seasonings and traditional mixtures count.
source: Corpora herbs_n_spices, CC0; herbs/spices/blends combined and synonyms merged.

prompt: Name a sauce, condiment, or relish served with food. Named traditional condiments count.
source: Corpora foods/condiments, CC0; ingredient names retained.

prompt: Name a chemical element with a two-letter symbol. An element name or its official symbol is accepted.
source: Corpora periodic table, CC0; IUPAC permanent names for elements 113,115,117,118 applied.

prompt: Name one of the first 1,000 numbered minor planets by name. Numbers alone do not count.
source: Corpora science/minor_planets, first 1,000 numbered objects, CC0. Numeric-only aliases intentionally excluded.

prompt: Name a film nominated for the Academy Award for Best Picture, through the 2026 ceremony. Winners count too.
source: Wikidata, film instances with P166/P1411 Academy Award for Best Picture (Q102427), English labels/aliases; CC0. Snapshot 2026-10-21, releases through 2025.

prompt: Name a film that won the Academy Award for Best Picture, through the 2026 ceremony.
source: Wikidata, film instances with P166/P1411 Academy Award for Best Picture (Q102427), English labels/aliases; CC0. Snapshot 2026-10-21, releases through 2025.

prompt: Name a river whose water eventually reaches the Atlantic, including the Mediterranean, Black Sea, Baltic, or Gulf of Mexico. Tributaries count.
source: Corpora rivers, CC0; outflows recursively traced to ocean basins. River Plate and Hudson Bay classified with Atlantic drainage. Finite long-river source; additional valid rivers may be absent.

prompt: Name a river whose water eventually reaches the Pacific or Indian Ocean. Tributaries count.
source: Corpora rivers, CC0; outflows recursively traced to ocean basins. River Plate and Hudson Bay classified with Atlantic drainage. Finite long-river source; additional valid rivers may be absent.

prompt: Name a river whose water eventually reaches the Arctic Ocean. Tributaries count.
source: Corpora rivers, CC0; outflows recursively traced to ocean basins. River Plate and Hudson Bay classified with Atlantic drainage. Finite long-river source; additional valid rivers may be absent.
